title: Cancer Diagnoses in England Reach Record High
subtitle: New figures show over 1,000 people diagnosed daily, raising questions about NHS capacity and care targets.

summary.en: Recent data reveals that cancer diagnoses in England have reached a record high of over 1,000 cases per day. While health officials note improvements in early detection, the NHS is struggling to meet its official waiting time targets for diagnosis and treatment. Experts point to an ageing population and lifestyle factors as key drivers behind the rising numbers. There are also concerns regarding health inequalities, where a person's background or location can affect their care. The government is now under pressure to provide more support and resources to the health service.
summary.zh: 近期數據顯示，英格蘭的癌症確診人數已達到每日超過一千例的歷史新高。儘管衛生官員指出早期檢測有所進步，但國民保健署在達成診斷與治療的官方等待時間目標上仍面臨困難。專家指出，人口老化與生活型態因素是導致數據上升的主要原因。此外，大眾也擔憂健康不平等問題，即個人的背景或居住地可能會影響其所獲得的照護。政府目前正面臨壓力，需為醫療體系提供更多支援與資源。

paragraphs.en: New data from the National Health Service (NHS) shows that cancer diagnoses in England have reached a record high. In 2024, more than 373,000 people were diagnosed with cancer, which averages to 1,021 new cases every single day. This is a significant increase from 2023, when the daily average was 972. These figures highlight the growing pressure on the health system, which is already facing challenges in providing timely care to patients across the country.
paragraphs.zh: 英國國民保健署（NHS）的最新數據顯示，英格蘭的癌症確診人數已創下歷史新高。二〇二四年，超過三十七萬三千人被診斷出罹患癌症，平均每天新增一千零二十一個病例。這與二〇二三年每日平均九百七十二例相比，有顯著增加。這些數據凸顯了醫療體系面臨的壓力日益沉重，該體系目前在為全國患者提供及時照護方面已面臨挑戰。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, four specific types of cancer—prostate, breast, lung, and bowel—account for half of all new diagnoses. While the rising numbers are concerning, there is some positive news regarding how early these cancers are found. In 2024, about 56.7% of first-time cancer cases were identified at stage 1 or 2, which are the earliest and most treatable stages. This is a slight improvement from 55.8% in 2023.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康版》（The Guardian Health）報導，四種特定癌症——攝護腺癌、乳癌、肺癌與大腸癌——佔了所有新確診病例的一半。儘管確診人數上升令人擔憂，但在癌症早期發現方面仍有一些正面消息。二〇二四年，約有百分之五十六點七的初次癌症病例是在第一期或第二期被發現的，這屬於最早且最容易治療的階段。相較於二〇二三年的百分之五十五點八，這是一個小幅度的進步。

paragraphs.en: Professor Peter Johnson, the NHS national clinical director for cancer, stated that these figures show the health service is moving in the right direction. He credited the hard work of NHS staff, who are bringing tests and checks closer to local communities. However, many experts are urging caution. Although more people are being diagnosed, the NHS is currently failing to meet its own official targets for how quickly patients should be seen. For example, the target is for 80% of patients to be diagnosed or have cancer ruled out within 28 days of an urgent referral. Recent figures show that only 78.6% of patients met this goal in August.
paragraphs.zh: 英國國民保健署癌症國家臨床主任強森教授（Professor Peter Johnson）表示，這些數據顯示醫療服務正朝正確的方向發展。他將此歸功於國民保健署工作人員的辛勤付出，他們正將檢測與篩檢服務推廣至更貼近在地社區的地方。然而，許多專家呼籲應保持謹慎。儘管確診人數增加，但國民保健署目前未能達到其官方設定的患者就診時效目標。例如，目標是百分之八十的患者在緊急轉診後的二十八天內獲得診斷或排除罹癌。近期數據顯示，八月份僅有百分之七十八點六的患者達到此目標。

paragraphs.en: The situation is even more difficult regarding treatment. The NHS aims for 85% of patients to begin their cancer treatment within 62 days of an urgent referral. Currently, only 71.9% of patients are starting their care within this timeframe. Dr. Ian Walker, the executive director of policy at Cancer Research UK, noted that while staff are working hard to diagnose more people, too many patients are still being caught at a late stage. He explained that the government must keep its focus on the national cancer plan to ensure patients are not let down by long waiting times.
paragraphs.zh: 在治療方面，情況甚至更為嚴峻。國民保健署的目標是讓百分之八十五的患者在緊急轉診後的六十二天內開始接受癌症治療。目前，僅有百分之七十一點九的患者能在該時限內開始治療。英國癌症研究協會（Cancer Research UK）政策執行總監沃克博士（Dr. Ian Walker）指出，雖然工作人員正努力診斷更多患者，但仍有太多患者在晚期才被發現。他解釋說，政府必須持續關注國家癌症計畫，以確保患者不會因為漫長的等待時間而受到耽誤。

paragraphs.en: Medical experts have identified several reasons for this increase in diagnoses. Dr. Hilary Williams, a consultant in medical oncology and clinical vice-president at the Royal College of Physicians, pointed out that an ageing population is a major factor. As people live longer, the risk of developing cancer increases. She also highlighted that obesity is a major, often ignored, risk factor that the health service must address. Dr. Williams emphasized that as more people live longer with cancer, the NHS must ensure they have access to the specialist support they need to maintain their quality of life.
paragraphs.zh: 醫學專家已找出導致確診人數增加的多項原因。皇家內科醫學院（Royal College of Physicians）醫學腫瘤學顧問兼臨床副院長威廉斯博士（Dr. Hilary Williams）指出，人口老化是一個主要因素。隨著人們壽命延長，罹患癌症的風險也隨之增加。她亦強調，肥胖是一個常被忽視的主要風險因子，醫療體系必須正視此問題。威廉斯博士強調，隨著越來越多的人帶癌長壽，國民保健署必須確保他們能獲得所需的專業支援，以維持生活品質。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the medical challenges, there are concerns about fairness in the healthcare system. Steven McIntosh, the chief partnerships officer at Macmillan Cancer Support, warned that the new figures mask persistent health inequalities. He noted that a person’s background and where they live can still have a significant impact on their likelihood of getting cancer, as well as how quickly they are diagnosed and treated. This follows recent reports on healthcare pressures, which highlighted how rural communities in particular are struggling with access to hospital services and the risk of delayed care.
paragraphs.zh: 除了醫療挑戰外，大眾也對醫療體系的公平性感到擔憂。麥克米倫癌症支援組織（Macmillan Cancer Support）的合作長麥金托什（Steven McIntosh）警告，這些新數據掩蓋了持續存在的健康不平等問題。他指出，個人的背景與居住地仍會對罹癌機率，以及診斷與治療的速度產生重大影響。在此之前，近期關於醫療壓力的報告也強調了偏鄉社區在獲取醫院服務與面臨延誤治療風險方面，正處於特別艱困的處境。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the path forward remains complex. The government has pledged to improve early diagnosis and reduce waiting times, but experts argue that this will not happen without focused effort. This includes providing the NHS with more specialist staff and better equipment. As the demand for cancer services continues to rise, the ability of the health service to adapt will be critical. For now, the focus remains on balancing the need for faster diagnosis with the reality of a system that is currently stretched to its limits.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，前進的道路依然複雜。政府已承諾改善早期診斷並縮短等待時間，但專家認為，若無專注的努力，這將難以實現。這包括為國民保健署提供更多專業人員與更好的設備。隨著對癌症服務的需求持續上升，醫療體系適應變化的能力將至關重要。目前，重點仍在於平衡快速診斷的需求，與醫療體系現已達到極限的現實。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make up a particular amount or proportion of a group.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見意思為「解釋」，這裡指佔總數的比例。文中：four specific types of cancer—prostate, breast, lung, and bowel—account for half of all new diagnoses.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To decide that something is not possible or is not the cause of a problem.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指醫生確認病人沒有罹患癌症。文中：the target is for 80% of patients to be diagnosed or have cancer ruled out within 28 days of an urgent referral.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to help or support someone as they expected.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指醫療系統未能提供應有的服務。文中：He explained that the government must keep its focus on the national cancer plan to ensure patients are not let down by long waiting times.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To hide or cover something so that it is not easily seen.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（面具），這裡作動詞，指數據掩蓋了背後的問題。文中：Steven McIntosh, the chief partnerships officer at Macmillan Cancer Support, warned that the new figures mask persistent health inequalities.

previousArticles.summaryEn: Recent reports highlight a growing crisis in healthcare delivery across Wales. Rural communities are fighting against plans to reduce hospital beds, fearing that care will become inaccessible. Simultaneously, patients are sharing stories of delayed cancer diagnoses due to systemic failures. These issues are worsened by a national shortage of radiologists who are needed to read medical scans. Experts and residents are calling for better infrastructure to ensure that patients receive timely treatment. The situation remains a major concern for families who rely on local health services.

quiz.question: According to the article, what percentage of patients were diagnosed or had cancer ruled out within the 28-day target in August?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，NHS 的目標是 80% 的患者能在 28 天內確診或排除癌症，但八月份的實際數據顯示只有 78.6% 的患者達標。選項 A 是早期診斷率（56.7%），選項 B 是 NHS 設定的官方目標值而非實際達成率，選項 D 則是 62 天內開始治療的達成率（71.9%），皆為干擾選項。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the current state of the NHS cancer services based on the provided text?

options.A: The NHS is successfully meeting all of its official targets for patient care.
options.B: The increase in cancer diagnoses is primarily caused by a lack of hospital equipment.
options.C: The system is struggling to balance a higher volume of patients with its current capacity.
options.D: The government has successfully eliminated health inequalities across the country.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。綜合全文，文章提到確診人數創新高，但 NHS 在診斷時效與治療時效上皆未達標，且面臨人力與資源壓力，顯示系統已達極限。選項 A 與文章描述的未達標事實矛盾；選項 B 將診斷增加歸咎於設備不足，但文中提到主因是人口老化與肥胖；選項 D 與第六段提到的「健康不平等依然持續存在」相違背。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'mask' mean as used in the sentence: '...the new figures mask persistent health inequalities'?

options.A: To hide or conceal the truth about something.
options.B: To wear a protective covering on one's face.
options.C: To decorate or paint over a surface.
options.D: To change the appearance of something to make it look better.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，'mask' 作為動詞，意指「掩蓋」或「隱藏」事實。作者意指這些整體數據掩蓋了背後持續存在的健康不平等問題。選項 B 是名詞用法（面具）；選項 C 與 D 雖然在某些語境下與外觀有關，但在本句中無法表達「隱藏真相」的含義，因此皆為錯誤。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article?

options.A: The NHS has successfully reduced cancer rates through better local community support.
options.B: Cancer research is the only way to solve the current healthcare crisis in England.
options.C: The NHS is facing significant challenges in managing record-high cancer diagnoses while struggling to meet performance targets.
options.D: The government should prioritize building more hospitals to address the needs of an ageing population.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心在於報導 NHS 癌症診斷人數創新高的現況，同時探討了該系統在處理這些病例時面臨的診斷時效、治療延遲、人口老化、肥胖問題及城鄉健康不平等等多重挑戰。選項 A 過度樂觀且與事實不符；選項 B 將重點侷限於研究，忽略了系統性挑戰；選項 D 僅提及解決方案之一，無法涵蓋全文關於診斷與治療壓力並存的主旨。
